initial_inventory: zero units for every method at episode start
information_timing: All five-period plans use episode-start features and no realized within-episode demand; all methods are evaluated on identical held-out paths.

sample_size_design.design_target: Normal-approximation target of 80% power for a paired standardized effect d=0.45 at two-sided alpha=0.025 for two primary comparisons.
sample_size_design.training_seed_unit: Training seeds are averaged within each episode and are not counted as independent cases.

methods.LightGBM_PTO: LightGBM point prediction followed by the common age-structured PIRP optimizer.
methods.LightGBM_Quantile_PTO: LightGBM quantile prediction at the inventory-cost critical fractile followed by the same optimizer.
methods.Crama_UL_lambda_adaptation: Validation-residual UL_lambda-inspired fixed-horizon order-up-to policy with shared route packing heuristic; not a faithful replication of Crama et al. (2018).
methods.Two-Phase_DFL: Approximate SPO+-inspired hybrid: LP warmup, vectorized polyhedral loss on most batches in runs of at least 50 epochs, and HiGHS integer-oracle requests on the first two batches of the final 10 epochs; feasible construction fallbacks are used when HiGHS returns no acceptable incumbent. Checkpoints are selected by realized validation cost. This is not a full-MILP-per-batch SPO+ implementation.

optimizer.implementation: Explicit SciPy HiGHS MILP request with LP-guided feasible construction fallback
optimizer.milp_fifo_state_parity: Each forecast plan is checked against the common FIFO simulator under its own planning demand; a max absolute discrepancy above 1e-4 stops the run.

calls_by_solver.solver_name: HiGHS MILP attempt + LP-guided feasible incumbent

primary_outcome: total operating cost per five-period synthetic episode
